title: Why So Many Buildings Collapsed in Turkey

sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的外面是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代冰淇淋。

sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝创立175周年，致力于帮您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠：nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布里纳·塔韦尔尼西，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: The scale of death in the earthquake in Turkey and Syria is now raising questions about who is to blame.
sentences.zh: 土耳其和叙利亚地震造成的巨大死亡人数，现在引发了关于谁该承担责任的质疑。

sentences.en: In Turkey, the government has placed that blame squarely on builders and property developers, accusing them of choosing profits over safety.
sentences.zh: 在土耳其，政府将责任直指建筑商和房地产开发商，指控他们将利润置于安全之上。

sentences.en: But the reality is far more complicated.
sentences.zh: 但现实远比这复杂得多。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Ben Hubbard on why a good part of the responsibility may rest with the Turkish government itself.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事本·哈伯德将为我们讲述，为什么很大一部分责任可能在于土耳其政府本身。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, February 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月28日，星期二。

sentences.en: So Ben, we're now at more than 50,000 dead in the earthquake in Turkey and Syria.
sentences.zh: 那么，本，土耳其和叙利亚地震的死亡人数现在已经超过了5万人。

sentences.en: And for weeks, the question we've all been asking is, how is it possible that so many people could have died?
sentences.zh: 几个星期以来，我们所有人都在追问的一个问题是：怎么可能会有这么多人死于这场地震？

sentences.en: You've been investigating that question in Turkey, where the loss of life was by far the greateSt.
sentences.zh: 你一直在土耳其调查这个问题，那里的生命损失是迄今为止最为惨重的。

sentences.en: Tell us what you've learned so far.
sentences.zh: 跟我们讲讲你目前了解到的情况。

sentences.en: The first thing we need to acknowledge is that this was a very powerful quake and it struck a very, very large territory.
sentences.zh: 我们需要承认的第一点是，这是一场威力巨大的地震，而且袭击了一个非常非常大的区域。

sentences.en: So that's what we're starting with.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们的切入点。

sentences.en: And when I got to the earthquake zone after this had happened, one of the first things that struck me is that not everything is knocked down.
sentences.zh: 当我在这场灾难发生后到达地震灾区时，给我留下的首要印象之一就是，并不是所有的建筑都倒塌了。

sentences.en: You have this sort of puzzling mosaic of like some areas where the buildings, at least from the outside, look more or less fine.
sentences.zh: 你会看到这种令人困惑的拼盘景象，有些区域的建筑至少从外观上看或多或少还算完好。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden you'll find one that's like completely flat.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，你会发现有一栋建筑完全被夷为平地。

sentences.en: There was one particular site that we went to where there was a work crew working trying to rescue some people who were trapped in the rubble.
sentences.zh: 我们去过一个特定的地点，那里有一支施工队正在努力营救被困在废墟中的人。

sentences.en: And there just happened to be a bunch of volunteer construction workers who were standing around sort of willing to help out.
sentences.zh: 当时现场正好站着一群志愿建筑工人，他们准备搭把手帮忙。

sentences.en: They were there with their hard hats and their equipment and they were inspecting the site and they were commenting on how the rebar that was there looked like it was poor quality.
sentences.zh: 他们戴着安全帽，带着设备在那里检查现场，并评论说那里的钢筋看起来质量很差。

sentences.en: The cement looks like it was kind of weak.
sentences.zh: 水泥看起来也有些劣质。

sentences.en: One of the guys literally walked over and picked up this big chunk of concrete and sort of tore it apart with his hands.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人甚至走过去，拿起这块巨大的混凝土，用手把它掰碎了。

sentences.en: And they were just all clicking their tongues and just really asking like, what happened here?
sentences.zh: 他们都在啧啧称奇，并且真诚地追问：这里究竟发生了什么？

sentences.en: Like, what was wrong with these buildings that fell down?
sentences.zh: 这些倒塌的建筑到底出了什么问题？

sentences.en: How were these buildings built?
sentences.zh: 这些建筑是怎么盖的？

sentences.en: Then this wondering about these buildings just turns into anger.
sentences.zh: 随后，对这些建筑的疑惑转变成了愤怒。

sentences.en: Almost a week after the earthquakes, the blame game begins.
sentences.zh: 地震发生将近一周后，指责的游戏开始了。

sentences.en: And the government responds and they respond by going after the builders.
sentences.zh: 政府做出了回应，而他们的回应就是向建筑商开刀。

sentences.en: Turkish authorities have issued arrest warrants for over a hundred people.
sentences.zh: 土耳其当局已经对一百多人发出了逮捕令。

sentences.en: They include contractors, architects and engineers accused of shoddy and illegal construction.
sentences.zh: 其中包括被控存在粗制滥造和非法施工行为的承包商、建筑师和工程师。

sentences.en: They start by arresting construction contractors, people who were linked to some of these buildings.
sentences.zh: 他们首先逮捕了建筑承包商，也就是那些与其中一些建筑有关联的人。

sentences.en: And then that really accelerates.
sentences.zh: 随后这一行动迅速加速。

sentences.en: Two property developers have reportedly been arrested at airports, accused of trying to flee the country.
sentences.zh: 据报道，已有两名房地产开发商在机场被捕，他们被指控企图逃离该国。

sentences.en: We've seen people who have been sort of perp walked on national television with their handcuffs on, sort of marching into the police car.
sentences.zh: 我们看到有人戴着手铐在全国电视直播中被押解着游街示众，被带上了警车。

sentences.en: So far, 188 people arrested, but more than 600 people have now been identified as potential suspects in relation to those allegations of construction negligence.
sentences.zh: 目前已有188人被捕，但针对这些涉嫌施工疏忽的指控，已有600多人被确定为潜在嫌疑人。

sentences.en: So the government is really putting the focus on the construction people, saying that, you know, these people are the problem.
sentences.zh: 因此，政府将焦点真正对准了建筑从业人员，声称这些人才是问题所在。

sentences.en: They're the ones who put up these buildings that weren't strong enough.
sentences.zh: 正是他们建造了这些不够坚固的建筑。

sentences.en: Okay, so the government is cracking down on the people it says are the guilty parties.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也就是说政府正在严厉打击它认定的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: In other words, the builders.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，就是建筑商。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But it turns out it's much, much more complicated than that.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，情况要复杂得多。

sentences.en: I mean, we, me and my colleagues here in Istanbul started looking into this, investigating who these people were, how the industry works, and just trying to figure out, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我和我在伊斯坦布尔的同事开始着手调查此事，弄清这些人都是谁、这个行业是如何运作的，并试图搞清楚，你知道的，

sentences.en: how did these buildings get built and what were the problems?
sentences.zh: 这些建筑究竟是怎么盖起来的？问题出在哪里？

sentences.en: Why were there buildings that came down and other ones that didn't?
sentences.zh: 为什么有些建筑倒塌了，而另一些没有？

sentences.en: And I mean, it's still very early in the process.
sentences.zh: 而且我的意思是，现在还为时过早。

sentences.en: It's difficult to sort of even identify some of these buildings and figure out who was responsible for them, who built them.
sentences.zh: 甚至连识别其中一些建筑、弄清楚究竟是谁对它们负责、是谁建造了它们，都非常困难。

sentences.en: But what we found is that the story really starts back in 1999.
sentences.zh: 但我们发现，这个故事实际上要追溯到1999年。

sentences.en: This was when you had the last really massive earthquake in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 那是土耳其上一次发生真正特大地震的时候。

sentences.en: Desperate rescue efforts were underway in western Turkey today after a massive earthquake struck during the night.
sentences.zh: 在夜间发生强烈地震后，土耳其西部今天正在展开绝望的搜救行动。

sentences.en: This is a very powerful earthquake that hits the city of Izmit, which is not far from Istanbul.
sentences.zh: 这是一场威力巨大的地震，袭击了距离伊斯坦布尔不远的伊兹米特市。

sentences.en: Some buildings swayed and survived, while others collapsed.
sentences.zh: 有些建筑摇晃后幸存了下来，而另一些则倒塌了。

sentences.en: According to local people, this one here may have fallen because the top two stories were cherry-built without official permission.
sentences.zh: 据当地人说，眼前这座建筑之所以倒塌，可能是因为顶部的两层楼是在没有官方许可的情况下违章加盖的。

sentences.en: There's huge, huge damage to this city, you know, collapsed buildings and people buried.
sentences.zh: 这座城市遭受了巨大、巨大的破坏，到处都是倒塌的建筑和被埋的人。

sentences.en: And it's just really, it's just a terrible situation.
sentences.zh: 这真的是，这真的是一个可怕的局面。

sentences.en: It kills more than 17,000 people.
sentences.zh: 它造成了1万7千多人死亡。

sentences.en: And the government is just wildly lambasted for its response.
sentences.zh: 政府的应对措施受到了极其猛烈的抨击。

sentences.en: This is do-it-yourself rescue, and it is chaos.
sentences.zh: 这是一场自力更生的救援，现场一片混乱。

sentences.en: There's just this sense that they had no ability to respond in time to get rescuers, to get aid in place for survivors.
sentences.zh: 人们普遍认为，他们根本没有能力及时做出反应，无法将救援人员和援助物资送到幸存者手中。

sentences.en: But as their shock wears off, the people's anger is starting to show.
sentences.zh: 但随着震惊逐渐消退，人们的愤怒开始显露出来。

sentences.en: A few years later, we have this huge economic crisis that really hits people's pocketbooks.
sentences.zh: 几年后，我们遭遇了一场沉重打击民众钱包的巨大经济危机。

sentences.en: And all of this together, this sense of just the country being so vulnerable to this terrible natural disaster,
sentences.zh: 所有这一切加在一起，既让人感到这个国家在面对这场可怕自然灾害时是如此脆弱，

sentences.en: plus all of the economic pain of this crisis, just creates this huge anger at the government that had been in place at the time.
sentences.zh: 再加上这场危机带来的全部经济痛苦，对当时执政的政府积聚了巨大的愤怒。

sentences.en: And this new party called the Justice and Development Party sort of rides this wave of anger.
sentences.zh: 而这个名为正义与发展党的新政党顺应了这股愤怒的浪潮。

sentences.en: What you're telling me with this welcome, with this interest, is that Turkey will go through a major change after the November elections.
sentences.zh: 你们对我的欢迎和关注向我表明，土耳其将在11月大选后经历重大变革。

sentences.en: They really campaigned on this idea that they were going to be more competent, less corrupt, and more transparent than the previous guys.
sentences.zh: 他们的竞选核心主张是，他们将比前任更有能力、更少腐败、更加透明。

sentences.en: I mean, the basic idea was that the previous parties had messed everything up, and we're going to come in and we're going to do a much, much better job.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，基本思路就是之前的政党把一切都搞砸了，而我们要上台，把工作做得好得多。

sentences.en: The Justice and Development Party won an overwhelming victory in Sunday's national elections.
sentences.zh: 正义与发展党在周日的全国大选中获得了压倒性胜利。

sentences.en: Enough voters believed that, that they brought them into the parliament, and they ended up with the ability in 2003 to name the prime minister.
sentences.zh: 足够多的选民相信了这一点，将他们送进了议会，并最终使他们在2003年获得了提名总理的权力。

sentences.en: And they chose at that time this up-and-coming politician named Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
sentences.zh: 他们当时选择了这位崭露头角的政治家，名叫雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安。
zh_words: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安

sentences.en: So, Recep Tayyip Erdogan, who's been running the country for 20 years now,
sentences.zh: 所以，执掌这个国家已经20年的雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安，
zh_words: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安

sentences.en: he really rises to power in a lot of ways off the back of this bungled political response from the previous government.
sentences.zh: 他在很大程度上正是凭借前政府拙劣的政治应对才得以崛起掌权的。

sentences.en: It definitely contributes to his rise.
sentences.zh: 这绝对促进了他的崛起。

sentences.en: And then, you know, in the next number of years, the country really takes off.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，在接下来的几年里，这个国家真正腾飞了。

sentences.en: Green fields on the outskirts of Istanbul.
sentences.zh: 伊斯坦布尔郊外的绿地。

sentences.en: Fields that will soon be transformed into a massive building site.
sentences.zh: 这些土地很快将被改造成巨大的建筑工地。

sentences.en: There's great economic growth, and a large part of that is really this idea of sort of build, build, build.
sentences.zh: 经济实现了巨大增长，而其中很大一部分都源于“大兴土木”的理念。

sentences.en: The skyline is changing rapidly as the city grows upwards and outwards.
sentences.zh: 随着城市向高空和四周扩展，天际线正在发生迅猛的变化。

sentences.en: Everything is going higher, faster, and further.
sentences.zh: 一切都在向更高、更快、更远发展。

sentences.en: When new buildings replace the old, a different economic class will move here.
sentences.zh: 当新建筑取代旧建筑时，一个不同的经济阶层将搬到这里。

sentences.en: There's large parts of society that rise into the middle class.
sentences.zh: 社会的大部分阶层都上升到了中产阶级。

sentences.en: There'll be upmarket properties designed to appeal to Turkey's burgeoning middle classes.
sentences.zh: 这里将建造旨在吸引土耳其不断壮大的中产阶级的优质房产。

sentences.en: This idea that, you know, you as a Turkish family can sort of have your own apartment in a nice city,
sentences.zh: 这种理念就是，作为土耳其家庭的你，可以在一个不错的城市拥有自己的公寓，

sentences.en: and this becomes a reality for huge parts of the population that were before, you know, quite impoverished.
sentences.zh: 而这对于以前相当贫困的庞大底层人口来说，已经变成了现实。

sentences.en: New shopping malls are opening up on an almost monthly basis.
sentences.zh: 新的购物中心几乎以每月一家的速度开业。

sentences.en: And there's just construction happening everywhere at this point.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，到处都在大兴土木。

sentences.en: And there's plenty of land waiting for development.
sentences.zh: 有大量的土地等待着开发。

sentences.en: So Erdogan's solution after the 1999 earthquake and economic crisis is to actually invest in building and development as a way to revive Turkey's economy.
sentences.zh: 因此，埃尔多安在1999年地震和经济危机之后的解决方案，实际上是通过投资建筑和开发来振兴土耳其经济。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But the dark side of all this construction is that Turkey has very, very active fault lines in large parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 但所有这些建设的阴暗面是，土耳其国内很大一部分地区都存在非常非常活跃的断层线。

sentences.en: This is a land that has histories of earthquakes going back as long as there is recorded history and really every reason to believe that there will be future powerful earthquakes.
sentences.zh: 这片土地有着自文字记录以来就存在的地震历史，而且有充分的理由相信未来还会发生强震。

sentences.en: So one of the things that the government is doing is really trying to reform how buildings are built,
sentences.zh: 因此，政府正在做的事情之一，就是真正试图改革建筑的建造方式，

sentences.en: upgrading building codes, upgrading standards for materials to try to ensure that the new buildings that are built are going to be able to withstand earthquakes.
sentences.zh: 升级建筑规范，提高材料标准，以努力确保新建的建筑能够抵御地震。

sentences.en: Right, because they don't want the buildings to collapse like they did in 1999.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为他们不想让建筑像1999年那样倒塌。

sentences.en: Yes, and so they've done things like upgrading the engineering calculations that you have to do to decide how much structure you need to support a building of a certain size.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以他们做了一些事情，比如升级工程计算，你必须通过计算来决定需要多少结构来支撑特定规模的建筑。

sentences.en: There's been work on the standards for what kind of materials you use, whether it's concrete or iron or rebar or these sorts of things,
sentences.zh: 他们还致力于规范所使用材料的标准，无论是混凝土、铁、钢筋还是诸如此类的东西，

sentences.en: and upgrading this basically as the technology develops.
sentences.zh: 并随着技术的发展基本上对这些进行升级。

sentences.en: And, you know, this process has been going on for a long time, but where Turkey's at now, everybody that we talked to basically said the codes are world class.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这个过程已经进行很长时间了，但就土耳其目前的现状而言，我们交谈过的每个人基本上都说这些规范是一流的。

sentences.en: Theoretically, these codes are some of the best that you could come up with to create earthquake-proof buildings.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，这些规范可以说是为了建造抗震建筑而能制定的最佳规范之一。

sentences.en: But when we've started looking into this in the last two weeks, what really became clear is that in a lot of cases, they're just not followed.
sentences.zh: 但当我们两周前开始调查此事时，真正显现出来的是，在许多情况下，它们根本没有被遵守。

sentences.en: Hold on.
sentences.zh: 等等。

sentences.en: So the Turkish government realizes there's a risk to all this construction.
sentences.zh: 所以土耳其政府意识到所有这些建设都存在风险。

sentences.en: They upgrade their building codes.
sentences.zh: 他们升级了建筑规范。

sentences.en: But why aren't people following them?
sentences.zh: 但为什么人们不遵守它们呢？

sentences.en: Part of it is that in the midst of this building boom, there's this kind of Wild West atmosphere that emerges.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是，在这股建筑热潮中，出现了一种类似于美国西部的蛮荒氛围。

sentences.en: So you ended up having huge problems in the inspections regime.
sentences.zh: 因此，你最终会在检查制度中遇到巨大的问题。

sentences.en: You know, ideally, to make sure that the rules are followed, you're going to have smart, independent inspectors going out, looking at the sites,
sentences.zh: 你知道，理想情况下，为了确保规则得到遵守，你需要精明、独立的检查人员去到现场进行查看，

sentences.en: finding out where things are not being done correctly, or poor materials are being used.
sentences.zh: 找出哪些地方没有按规定做好，或者使用了劣质材料。

sentences.en: And in a lot of cases, this is just not happening.
sentences.zh: 但在很多情况下，这根本没有发生。

sentences.en: There was a practice of construction companies being able to hire private inspection companies to come out to their sites and do the inspections.
sentences.zh: 过去有一种做法，即建筑公司可以聘请私人检查公司到他们的工地进行检查。

sentences.en: Private inspection companies?
sentences.zh: 私人检查公司？

sentences.en: Like, isn't that the government's job?
sentences.zh: 这难道不是政府的工作吗？

sentences.en: Of course, it should be the government's job.
sentences.zh: 当然，这本该是政府的工作。

sentences.en: But they were able to hire these private companies.
sentences.zh: 但他们却能够雇用这些私营公司。

sentences.en: And private inspection companies want to keep getting work.
sentences.zh: 而且私营检查公司想要不断接活。

sentences.en: And if they get a reputation for shutting down people's projects, they're not going to get hired anymore.
sentences.zh: 如果他们因叫停别人的项目而落下名声，他们就再也不会被雇用了。

sentences.en: So they sort of have an incentive to approve projects that maybe they should not.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有一种动力去批准本不应该批准的项目。

sentences.en: Wow, that's complete conflict of interest, right?
sentences.zh: 哇，这完全是利益冲突，对吧？

sentences.en: That's crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Well, it gets even worse than that, because in some cases, according to a lot of the industry professionals we talked to, construction companies would actually set up their own
sentences.zh: 嗯，情况甚至比这还要糟糕，因为根据我们交谈过的许多行业专业人士的说法，建筑公司实际上会自己设立

sentences.en: inspection companies.
sentences.zh: 检查公司。

sentences.en: And so they would effectively be hiring themselves to inspect their own projects.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们实际上是在雇用自己来检查他们自己的项目。

sentences.en: So the government just completely abdicated responsibility for this really important function.
sentences.zh: 所以政府完全放弃了对这一极其重要职能的责任。

sentences.en: I would say there were significant holes in the checks that were put in place to ensure that these codes were followed.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，在确保遵守这些规范而设置的检查环节中，存在着巨大的漏洞。

sentences.en: And the result of that is that there were buildings that went up that were not nearly as strong as they should have been.
sentences.zh: 其结果就是，有些拔地而起的建筑远没有它们应有的那么坚固。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了“连线”（Connections）游戏，这是《纽约时报》益智游戏的一种。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天都制作“拼写蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“字母箱”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的益智游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So Ben, you've just finished telling us that Turkey's earthquake codes were really world class, but they weren't really enforced.
sentences.zh: 那么，本，你刚刚告诉我们，土耳其的抗震规范确实是一流的，但它们并没有得到真正的执行。

sentences.en: So is Erdogan just fine with all of this?
sentences.zh: 所以埃尔多安对这一切都觉得无所谓吗？

sentences.en: Like, isn't he worried that this could come back to bite him?
sentences.zh: 难道他不担心这会反过来害了他吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, you would think because of his history that, you know, of all the politicians in Turkey,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，按理说由于他的过往经历，你知道的，在土耳其所有的政客中，

sentences.en: he would be incredibly attuned to the tremendous power that earthquakes have to affect politics.
sentences.zh: 他应该对地震对政治造成的巨大破坏力有着极高的敏感度。

sentences.en: But there hasn't been a whole lot of sign of that.
sentences.zh: 但几乎看不到这方面的迹象。

sentences.en: And in fact, this government has been quite cavalier about it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，现任政府对此一直相当漫不经心。

sentences.en: I mean, over the years, they've pushed through these things that are known as building amnesties.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，多年来，他们强行推行了这些被称为建筑特赦的政策。

sentences.en: What are they?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: So there are lots of buildings in Turkey that are not up to code.
sentences.zh: 土耳其有大量建筑并不符合规范。

sentences.en: And over time, the government becomes aware of these.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，政府也注意到了这些情况。

sentences.en: Either inspectors find that, you know, somebody has enclosed their balcony without a permit.
sentences.zh: 要么是检查员发现，你知道的，有人在没有许可证的情况下封闭了阳台。

sentences.en: Somebody has added a few floors to their building, perhaps to earn a bit of extra rent money.
sentences.zh: 有人在楼上加盖了几层，也许是为了多赚点租金。

sentences.en: Somebody has decided to sell the ground floor to some business who cuts out some of the pillars to get more space.
sentences.zh: 有人决定把底层卖给某家为了获得更多空间而拆掉部分承重柱的企业。

sentences.en: And this comes to the government's attention, either because inspectors find it or because the neighbors sue.
sentences.zh: 这些情况引起了政府的注意，要么是因为检查员发现了，要么是因为邻居起诉了。

sentences.en: So you have these cases of code violations that just pile up and pile up.
sentences.zh: 所以你会发现违规建筑的案例不断堆积。

sentences.en: And every once in a while, the government basically issues an amnesty where they wipe the slate clean.
sentences.zh: 每隔一段时间，政府基本上就会发布一次特赦，一笔勾销过往的问题。

sentences.en: The way that it works is that if you have been reported for having done something to your building that violates the code, you pay a fine.
sentences.zh: 它的运作方式是，如果你因对建筑进行了违规操作而被举报，你只需要交罚款就行。

sentences.en: And in a lot of cases, people don't even have to fix what it is that they had the code violation for, even if it's something like cutting the ground floor pillars of a building,
sentences.zh: 在很多情况下，人们甚至不需要去修复违规的地方，哪怕这类似于砍掉建筑的底层柱子，

sentences.en: which could very much make it more vulnerable than an earthquake.
sentences.zh: 这很可能会让建筑在地震面前变得更加不堪一击。

sentences.en: So basically, the government is waiving all of these violations, despite the fact that they could lead to some pretty dangerous situations.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，尽管这些行为可能会导致相当危险的局面，政府还是豁免了所有这些违规行为。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So on top of the fact that the system of building inspections is pretty spotty, even when the inspections do turn something up and they find violations of the building code,
sentences.zh: 因此，除了建筑检查制度本身就漏洞百出之外，即使检查确实发现了一些问题并找到了违反建筑规范的地方，

sentences.en: the government sometimes just forgives them.
sentences.zh: 政府有时也会直接既往不咎。

sentences.en: But why?
sentences.zh: 但为什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, there's a number of reasons.
sentences.zh: 原因有很多。

sentences.en: First is that the government earns money off of it.
sentences.zh: 首先是政府能从中赚钱。

sentences.en: I mean, everybody who has code violations that they want forgiven, they pay a fine.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，所有希望违规行为被原谅的人都要交罚款。

sentences.en: In the most recent amnesty, this ended up bringing more than $4 billion into the government purse.
sentences.zh: 在最近的一次特赦中，这最终为政府带来了超过40亿美元的收入。

sentences.en: So, you know, there's a reason that the government likes it.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，政府喜欢它是有原因的。

sentences.en: And voters really like it.
sentences.zh: 而且选民也非常喜欢。

sentences.en: People invest money in property.
sentences.zh: 人们在房产上投资。

sentences.en: You know, if you're a hardworking Turkish family and you've taken your savings and you've bought a family apartment or a family home,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你是一个努力工作的土耳其家庭，你拿出了积蓄买了一套公寓或住宅，

sentences.en: the last thing you want is for the government to come and find a code violation and condemn the building or knock it down because you're going to lose your investment.
sentences.zh: 你最不希望看到的就是政府跑来挑出违规毛病，然后宣布这栋楼为危楼或者直接把它拆了，因为这样你会血本无归。

sentences.en: So people love these things.
sentences.zh: 所以人们非常喜欢这种政策。

sentences.en: And this is why they tend to happen during elections.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么这类政策往往在选举期间出台。

sentences.en: The most recent one was put in place during the presidential election in 2018.
sentences.zh: 最近的一次是在2018年总统选举期间推出的。

sentences.en: And the year after, Erdogan goes on the campaign trail in local elections and is basically bragging about it to people saying, look at this great thing that we did.
sentences.zh: 一年后，埃尔多安在地方选举中四处拉票，基本上在向人们夸耀此事，说看看我们做的好事。

sentences.en: In this town, we forgave X number of code violations.
sentences.zh: 在这个城镇里，我们免除了多少多少起违规建筑问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, portraying this as this great service that we've done to the people.
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道的，把这描绘成我们为人民做的一件大好事。

sentences.en: And ultimately, this most recent round of amnesty, they ended up forgiving code violations on more than 7 million units across the country.
sentences.zh: 最终，最近这轮特赦免除了全国超过700万个单元的违规建筑问题。

sentences.en: Which sounds like a lot of units.
sentences.zh: 听起来数量很多。

sentences.en: Is it?
sentences.zh: 确实如此吗？

sentences.en: How do I understand that number?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么理解这个数字？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it's a country of about 80 million people.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，这是一个拥有约8000万人口的国家。

sentences.en: So yeah, 7 million units, it's a lot of units.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，700万个单元，数量确实庞大。

sentences.en: But weren't people worried about the safety of their homes?
sentences.zh: 但难道人们不担心自己住所的安全吗？

sentences.en: I mean, there are definitely people who are concerned.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，确实有人感到担忧。

sentences.en: You know, there's a whole group of seismologists in Turkey who have really been sounding the alarm
sentences.zh: 你知道的，土耳其有一整批地震学家一直在敲响警钟，

sentences.en: and making it very clear that according to all of the science, it's just only a matter of time before more powerful earthquakes hit Turkey.
sentences.zh: 并明确指出，根据所有科学规律，更强烈的地震袭击土耳其只是时间问题。

sentences.en: I think a lot of them feel like nobody really listens to them.
sentences.zh: 我想他们中的很多人觉得根本没有人真正听取他们的意见。

sentences.en: You do have inspectors, you do have engineers and people pointing things out.
sentences.zh: 你确实有检查员，有工程师和指出问题的人。

sentences.en: I mean, there was a couple that we interviewed, two lawyers who had filed 51 court cases against this one builder in their town
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们采访过一对夫妇，他们是两位律师，曾针对他们镇上的某个建筑商提起了51起诉讼，

sentences.en: because they thought that he was violating the code all over the place.
sentences.zh: 因为他们认为这家伙到处都在违规建设。

sentences.en: So there were definitely people who were looking out for this.
sentences.zh: 所以确实有人在密切关注这些问题。

sentences.en: But there's something that I think is just human nature in thinking about something like an earthquake that nobody knows when it's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 但在思考地震这种谁也不知道什么时候会发生的事情时，我觉得有一种人类的本性在起作用。

sentences.en: It could happen tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 它可能明天发生。

sentences.en: It could happen next week.
sentences.zh: 它可能下周发生。

sentences.en: It could happen 100 years from now.
sentences.zh: 它可能在100年后发生。

sentences.en: I think it's sometimes hard before the actual earthquake comes for people to conceive what it's going to look like and what it's going to mean for their lives.
sentences.zh: 我认为在真正的大地震来临之前，人们有时很难想象它会是什么样子，以及它对他们的生活意味着什么。

sentences.en: And, you know, it allows people to kind of go along with this magical thinking of like, maybe we'll just dodge the bullet.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这让人们能够顺从这种侥幸心理，觉得也许我们能躲过一劫。

sentences.en: Like it's a distant danger, not an immediate one.
sentences.zh: 就像这是一种遥远的危险，而不是迫在眉睫的威胁。

sentences.en: And therefore, I'm going to think about it on a different day.
sentences.zh: 因此，我要改天再想这事。

sentences.en: I'm not going to think about it today.
sentences.zh: 我今天不去想它。

sentences.en: I mean, it's not unlike climate change in that it's this danger that people know is sort of looming in the future.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这与气候变化有点相似，这种危险人们知道它正隐约潜伏在未来。

sentences.en: But even if you're convinced that it's there, it's still in your daily life feels kind of remote.
sentences.zh: 但即使你确信它的存在，在日常生活中它依然显得有些遥远。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, you have other things to worry about that feel much more pressing.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，你还有其他感觉更加紧迫的事情需要操心。

sentences.en: And so it's, I think, human nature to focus on the things that are right before you.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，关注眼前的事务是人类的本性。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But it's incumbent on government to actually force people to do the right thing, right, collectively.
sentences.zh: 但政府理应强迫人们从集体层面去做正确的事，对吧？

sentences.en: But in this case, the Turkish government didn't.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，土耳其政府并没有这样做。

sentences.en: It actually made things worse.
sentences.zh: 它实际上让事情变得更糟了。

sentences.en: Which leads me back to Erdogan.
sentences.zh: 这让我又想到了埃尔多安。

sentences.en: He's arrested these builders.
sentences.zh: 他逮捕了这些建筑商。

sentences.en: But what about him?
sentences.zh: 但他呢？

sentences.en: Will he and his party have to pay a price for this?
sentences.zh: 他和他的政党是否会为此付出代价？

sentences.en: Well, the big test is going to be elections.
sentences.zh: 嗯，最大的考验将是选举。

sentences.en: There are parliamentary and presidential elections expected in May.
sentences.zh: 预计在五月举行议会和总统选举。

sentences.en: And these are crucial for him.
sentences.zh: 这对他的政治生涯至关重要。

sentences.en: I mean, he would like to stay in power.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他很想继续当权。

sentences.en: He's been having a hard time in the polls this year, largely because of economic troubles at home.
sentences.zh: 今年他在民调中日子不好过，很大程度上是因为国内的经济困境。

sentences.en: Lots of voters were quite mad at the way that he had been running the country before the earthquake even hit.
sentences.zh: 甚至在地震发生之前，许多选民就对他的治国方式相当不满。

sentences.en: And then they have, you know, this huge natural disaster that's killed all these people.
sentences.zh: 然后他们又遭遇了这场造成无数人死亡的巨大自然灾害。

sentences.en: And it's hard to see how that benefits him at all in this election.
sentences.zh: 很难看出这对他在这场选举中有任何好处。

sentences.en: And so he's been, almost every day, he's been down in the earthquake zone with this very grave look on his face, wearing this long black coat,
sentences.zh: 因此，他几乎每天都面色凝重地出现在地震灾区，身上穿着那件长款黑大衣，

sentences.en: meeting with people who were living in tent cities, meeting with earthquake victims and seeing the rubble.
sentences.zh: 与住在帐篷城的人们见面，会见地震灾民并视察废墟。

sentences.en: And, you know, really showing this kind of tangible connection with this disaster that's gone on.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，真正展现出与这场持续灾难的这种切身联系。

sentences.en: And we're going to have to wait and see how that really resonates with voters.
sentences.zh: 我们只能拭目以待，看这在选民中究竟能引起多大的共鸣。

sentences.en: He has not spoken much about everything that we've been talking about, about how did all these buildings end up getting built
sentences.zh: 对于我们一直在讨论的这一切，关于所有这些建筑最终是如何建造出来的——

sentences.en: that didn't seem like they were done right to withstand an earthquake.
sentences.zh: 看起来并没有做好抗震准备——他并没有多说什么。

sentences.en: The most that he said is, we as a country have things that we need to learn from this disaster, and we should do better in the future.
sentences.zh: 他最多说过的话是，我们作为一个国家需要从这场灾难中吸取教训，未来我们应该做得更好。

sentences.en: That's kind of as much as we've gotten.
sentences.zh: 差不多也就得到这些表态了。

sentences.en: But interestingly, what he's promised, I think the biggest promise that he's made to his people, is that we're going to rebuild.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，他承诺的内容，我认为他向人民作出的最大承诺是，我们将要重建。

sentences.en: Basically, there's going to be more construction.
sentences.zh: 基本上，会有更多的建设。

sentences.en: He said that we're going to start in March, and he wants to rebuild homes for all these people within a year.
sentences.zh: 他说我们将于三月开始动工，并希望在一年内为所有人重建家园。

sentences.en: I mean, which is a quite remarkable and incredibly ambitious promise.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个相当惊人且极具雄心的承诺。

sentences.en: So instead of saying, we need enforcement, we really need to look at how we're doing this, he's saying construction is the answer.
sentences.zh: 所以他没有说我们需要执法、我们真的需要审视我们的做法，而是说建设才是答案。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's really a doubling down on this policy that's been such a large part of his tenure.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实是在加倍奉行那种在他的任期内占据如此大比重的政策。

sentences.en: It's still build, build, build.
sentences.zh: 依然是建设，建设，再建设。

sentences.en: That's the solution.
sentences.zh: 这就是解决方案。

sentences.en: And, you know, Erdogan has proven over the 20 years that he's been on the national stage that he's a survivor.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，埃尔多安在其登上国家政治舞台的20年里已经证明了自己是一个生存高手。

sentences.en: He's a very deft politician.
sentences.zh: 他是一位非常精明的政治家。

sentences.en: And, you know, even with a challenge as large as an earthquake of this magnitude, there's a chance that he's going to push through
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道的，即便面对如此规模巨大的地震挑战，他依然有可能挺过难关，

sentences.en: and that he's going to find a way to win this election.
sentences.zh: 并且他会找到赢得这次选举的方法。

sentences.en: But there's really also this sense of history echoing itself, that, you know, it was a catastrophic earthquake that helped fuel Erdogan's rise to the national stage.
sentences.zh: 但这里也有一种历史重演的感觉，你知道的，正是一场灾难性地震推动了埃尔多安登上国家政治舞台。

sentences.en: And here we are 20 years later, and it's another catastrophic earthquake that he's got to face now and that, in a lot of ways, could really imperil his political future.
sentences.zh: 20年后的今天，又是一场灾难性地震横亘在他面前，在许多方面，这真的可能危及他的政治未来。

sentences.en: Ben, thank you.
sentences.zh: 本，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Monday, Rupert Murdoch, chairman of the conservative media empire that owns Fox News, acknowledged that several hosts for his networks
sentences.zh: 周一，拥有福克斯新闻的保守派媒体帝国董事长鲁珀特·默多克承认，他旗下的几位主持人

sentences.en: promoted the false narrative that the 2020 election was stolen from former President Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 宣扬了2020年大选是从前总统唐纳德·特朗普手中被窃取的虚假阴谋论。

sentences.en: In court documents released on Monday that are part of a lawsuit by Dominion Voting Systems,
sentences.zh: 在周一公开的作为多米尼、投票系统诉讼一部分的法庭文件中，

sentences.en: Murdoch said that Fox hosts Sean Hannity,
sentences.zh: 默多克表示，福克斯主持人肖恩·汉尼提、

sentences.en: Jeanine Pirro, Lou Dobbs, and Maria Bartiromo, quote, endorsed the false theory.
sentences.zh: 珍妮·皮罗、娄·多布斯和玛丽亚·巴蒂罗莫，用他的话说，认可了这一虚假理论。

sentences.en: He said, quote, I would have liked us to be stronger in denouncing it in hindsight.
sentences.zh: 他说，引述：“事后看来，我希望我们在谴责它时能够更坚定一些。”

sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尔尼西。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《切割机秀》将为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是遮光睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会一觉睡死过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，有食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
